avoid_for: Consumer retail and playful multi-color brands, image-led hero marketing, and any interface needing bold (600+) headlines, pure-white backgrounds, or sans-serif body text — the serif-mono pairing and warm parchment canvas define the identity, and swapping them breaks it.
best_for: Developer-tool and data-infrastructure landing pages wanting a literary technical register — warm parchment canvas, editorial serif headlines, monospace body, and a data-pipeline diagram as the visual centerpiece.
name: Monad
palette_voice: Warm Parchment (#f6f3f1) is the signature canvas and most surface fills — never pure white; Off-Black (#242424) and Graphite (#4e4d4d) carry text while 1px Ash (#cecac8) hairlines define all edges; a single vivid Lake Blue (#2b59d1) is the only saturated fill, reserved for the primary action only; Periwinkle Mist (#cfdaf5) elevates one card and pastel gradient washes (coral, sky, mint, gold) stay strictly decorative inside illustrations; one subtle ambient shadow token exists but cards prefer borders and surface contrast.
signature_moves: The serif-mono pairing — Untitled Serif at weight 400 for all headlines, ABC Diatype Mono for every body/nav/button/UI string — the serif announces, the mono instructs
Uppercase + tight-tracking mono labels on nav, buttons, and tags (18px / 14px), making functional text read as data
Lake Blue pill button with a trailing arrow as the single saturated conversion action per screen
The custom data-pipeline diagram — pill-shaped bordered nodes connected by thin curved Ash lines, the page's visual centerpiece
Soft gradient atmospheric washes (Coral → Sky Blue → Mint) with blur(50–75px) as decorative halos behind hero content
tagline: editorial tech journal on warm parchment
typographic_voice: A two-voice system: Untitled Serif (subst. Times/Georgia) at weight 400 locked across all sizes (24–80px) with -0.02em tracking carries editorial authority through stroke contrast rather than weight — headlines whisper, never shout; ABC Diatype Mono (subst. JetBrains Mono) handles all body, nav, buttons, badges, and tags at 12–20px with negative tracking, reading as data not marketing; no bold headings, no sans body, no pure-white canvas.
